text:
zoe: Quick sync — folding some feedback from the research calls into the sample picker + quickstart banner. Not urgent but want alignment before design handoff.

marc: TL;DR of research?

zoe: Two themes: newbies want a single obvious action; power users want explicit labels about resource needs (dedicated vs hosted). Also keyboard users want predictable tab order.

lee: Seeing screenshots helps. Link: https://drive.company/internal/designs/sample-picker-v2.png

riley: Banner copy idea: "Run a curated sample" (headline) + "Try a working example in your workspace in under a minute" (sub). CTA: "Run sample". We should avoid "Get started" here.

marc: Agree on "Run sample". Also we should show an inline micro-label on cards like "1-min demo" but only for tiny samples. Don't spam it.

lee: Accessibility: current picker has cards implemented as divs with click handlers. Need role=button and keyboard handlers, plus aria-pressed when selected. Tab order should be card grid then CTA not the other way.

riley: On mobile the banner CTA is cramped when we show sample count. Proposal: hide sample count on small widths and show only primary CTA.

zoe: Error copy when a sample fails to launch: "Sample failed to run \u2014 try again or open the checklist. Copy error for support." Add a small "Copy error" affordance and a link to docs.

marc: QA: can qa-bot add a smoke test for the sample launch flow that asserts CTA visible and keyboard nav works?

qa-bot: I can. Will add tests to the onboarding e2e suite: `onboard.sample_launch_smoke` with steps for keyboard nav and a11y snapshot. ETA 3 days.

lee: Visual tweak: the "1-min demo" pill currently uses a 2px border which clashes in dark mode; remove border in dark mode and increase horizontal padding to 8px.

riley: Also unify casing: headline Title Case, description sentence case. We should be consistent across quickstart surfaces.

zoe: Telemetry ask: record `sample_picker_open`, `sample_selected`, `sample_run_attempt`, `sample_run_error` with sample_slug and user_new boolean. Marc can you confirm event names?

marc: yes those names are fine. include `error_code` for run_error.

zoe: Action items:
- lee: add role/button and keyboard handlers to cards + adjust tab order (PR by Wed)
- marc: wire telemetry and confirm event schema (PR by Thu)
- riley: update mobile banner responsive rules + hide sample count (PR by Wed)
- qa-bot: add smoke e2e and a11y snapshot (in 3 days)
- zoe: update copy variants and push to design handoff (by end of week)

marc: I'll also add a small A/B where Variant A shows time labels only on tiny demos and Variant B shows badges on all samples. Run 2 weeks.

zoe: cool. anyone opposed to the copy above?

lee: no objections. I'll start the PR and ping eng-runtime for perf impact of sample preloads.

riley: thumbs up from me.

qa-bot: noted and creating test ticket now.

zoe: thanks all — closing the loop here.
